protocol.baseline_comparison: v1.5 original out-of-fold joint residual plus historical v1.4 fold experts, never all-seven final model on scored folds
protocol.exposure: All seven Sportec matches previously exposed development. Fresh labels never used for training or candidate selection.
protocol.fresh_audit_policy: Audit one frozen experimental winner even if development fails; promotion requires both development and new fresh gates. No runner-up or retuning.

gate.ranking: equal mean of primary spellF1, all-condition short recall and all-condition D boundary F1, then primary spellF1, then candidate name

stoppage_weighting.class_normalization: preserve original weighted mass separately for D/live in each half
stoppage_weighting.unknown_policy: X and zero-weight observations split valid runs

release_decision.reason: Retained v1.5: experimental combined did not pass both fixed gates (development=False, fresh=False).
